%%LEAD%%

Executives framed the move as part of a multi-year plan to sharpen the brand promise while keeping a tight grip on operating costs. Early reads from pilot markets point to stronger foot traffic and a measurable lift in basket size across key categories.

The announcement lands as shoppers grow more selective, rewarding retailers that pair clear value with a coherent story across stores, apps and marketplaces. Analysts say the winners will be chains that turn first-party data into faster, more local decisions.

Looking ahead, the company plans to extend the initiative through the holiday quarter, backed by a media mix weighted toward retail media networks and creator partnerships. Suppliers briefed on the plan describe it as ambitious but grounded in realistic sell-through assumptions. %%EXTRA%%
